scope: Read-only code and ZIP inspection. SQLite seed deserialized in memory. No extraction writes, installation, inference or server launch. Only audit report files written.

nonblocking_findings.message: START_HERE says macOS runtime/inference needs OpenMP; archival API runtime has no LightGBM import and requirements-runtime only installs FastAPI/Pydantic/Uvicorn. OpenMP belongs to the optional inference path. This overstates the API prerequisite, not a data-loss defect.

limits: Launcher preservation assessed statically here; parent performs real clean-environment and restart tests separately. Hard-link publication fails safely if filesystem does not support links; universal filesystem portability is not claimed.
Existing runtime DB is neither overwritten nor included in immutable input verification. Runtime recovery/backup is separate; no power-loss durability or disk-failure guarantee assessed.
Manifest detects changed bundle members when trusted; it is not a signature. The ZIP includes supplied data and weights and remains local.
Pattern scan and allowlist found no credentials or copied dispatcher history; this is not a universal secret-detection guarantee.
Legacy original demo JSON contains separately revealable historical outcomes by design; the six immutable replay payloads pass the no-future-outcome store validator.

Excluded combined/selection manifest and nonselected candidates are only needed for training/evaluation paths, which START_HERE explicitly excludes. Frozen inference sources/models/inputs are present and hash-consistent.
